m2-producer.title: Pure producer: declaration -> manifest envelope
m2-producer.imperative: Implement the pure producer in scripts/context_manifest.py: resolve an ordered context_refs declaration against an injected root mapping (skill|repo|durable) through a single injected filesystem reader edge, emitting {contract, step, files:[{root,path,rev}], run}. Absent file -> rev null, entry retained. Unreadable present file -> raise. Path escaping its declared root -> raise. No globs, no listdir, no sorted() over paths; declaration order emitted verbatim. Absolute roots never appear in content. Mirror the engine's _STATE_CONTRACT_VERSION idiom for contract. Serialise json.dumps(obj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+chr(10), write with open(..., 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n'). Tests for each behavior.

postconditions.statement: producer emits the one envelope with the {root,path,rev} row; null-on-absent, raise-on-unreadable, raise-on-traversal, order-verbatim all covered by green tests

constraints: run subtree is the entire exclusion set

why_trail.why: Handoff verified complete against all nine required fields; the settled design (rev = LF-normalised blob OID, optional ordered context_refs, one envelope with /run as the entire exclusion set, no CLI verb, no committed artifact per Tommy's ruling) is understood and will be implemented as specified, not redesigned.

rev() is the LF-normalised blob OID and now provably equals git hash-object AND git rev-parse HEAD:<path> for four real tracked clean files (36b3f7c0... for scripts/checklist_engine.py), and CRLF/LF twins agree (fbbee861... for both). The discriminating red proves the tests catch the exact bug the design fears.

The producer is one pure function of (checklist, roots, reader) with the reader as the single injected impure edge. Row is exactly {root,path,rev}; required stays in the declaration; absent yields null with the row retained; unreadable and root-escaping paths raise; declaration order is emitted verbatim and a permutation registers as a content difference; no absolute root reaches content. 24 tests green.

Selection is the engine's own active_id: the function the producer calls is compiled from scripts/checklist_engine.py (asserted via __code__.co_filename) and context_manifest.py defines no second selector. Step tracks active_id across a three-item run and raises when every item is terminal. All 13 real committed gated spine templates project without crashing and yield empty files when they carry no context_refs.

The Commander spine template's context step now carries a six-entry ordered context_refs declaration in the imperative's own reading order (inherited global doctrine, then project deltas, then durable lessons), added beside constraints/directives. The imperative prose is untouched, verified by asserting the substitute-and-record and sanctioned-degradation clauses are still present. Only the context step carries a declaration; the template still parses and every other step is byte-identical (diff: 8 insertions, 0 deletions).

Adversarial fixtures ship in tests/fixtures/context_declarations.json (12 rejected declarations, 4 accepted) and drive parameterized tests: order permutation registers as a content difference, changed bytes never revalidate a stale rev, untracked-vs-absent differs only in one honest rev, CRLF/LF twins agree. The three named guards are AST-precise rather than grep-based, so the module's own prose cannot false-positive: no enumeration/sorted names used, every text open() pins newline='\n', no 3.13+ API in the producer or its tests. A decoy sibling file plus booby-trapped os.listdir/scandir/walk prove enumeration behaviourally, not just by inspection.

Two clean git worktree checkouts of the same commit, at distinct absolute paths, each running the real producer in its own process under LC_ALL/LANG C vs tr_TR.UTF-8 and PYTHONHASHSEED 1 vs 4242. Content sha256 ece8363c... in BOTH; whole-file sha256 differs (62e1c3f8 vs 4df101e4) exactly because /run varies, which is the point. Locale and seed mutations are asserted to have reached the child (hash('constellation') differs, proving PYTHONHASHSEED was honoured, not merely set). Exclusion set is exactly {'run'} — nothing else masked. The first run passed vacuously (all revs null in a bare source checkout), so an install shim now materialises the two _shared doctrine files, making the projection non-trivial; a guard test now fails if the projection is empty. No stray worktrees: 5 before, 5 after.

All seven handoff verification commands exit 0, including the full suite (1209 passed, 2 pre-existing skips) and the .gitattributes LF-normalisation invariant that rev()'s equality with git hash-object depends on. IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.md is written with the four load-bearing evidence transcripts pasted verbatim (rev vs git hash-object AND git rev-parse, CRLF/LF twins, the manifest driven through active_id, and the two-checkout determinism run showing distinct paths, verified locale/seed mutation, and CONTENT sha256 equality with exactly ['run'] excluded). Two false-green traps were found and fixed rather than banked: the determinism test measured HEAD instead of the change, and the projection was vacuously all-null.
